12: 1. Through falsehood, one's words are not heard. Also through falsehood, one becomes a widower G-d forbid, from several women.

2. When a man's wife dies, it is as if he is missing one of his bones. But the tzaddik, even though his wife passed away, he is not deficient a bone. This is (hinted at in the word) alman<widower>, the acronym for: "Not one of them is broken." (a'chas m'ayhem l'oe n'ishbara).
